about: Quick's fold (A-28, Q-05: past six modules Quick shows six and a button names the rest; the Pedalboard, a source and a module holding a set value are never folded; its open state is kept with the session), built after the consolidation round: the concept's two scenarios about it, moved here from fix-core.json's excluded, and the fold's own (38-fold.mjs), each reaching its state by real input once the concept's two stand-in modules are on the desk. 38-fold.mjs holds on the concept page too but for the one its `why` names (--page hotstep-tiers.html).

scenarios.why: The concept's own: eight modules show all eight, eight and the Pedalboard all nine, ten and the board fold four behind a button that names them, a changed value keeps its module in sight, a ring aimed at a folded tile opens the fold, and the button folds them again; then the parked tray and the empty desk. The stand-ins are the test build's definitions (testing/standins.ts), named by the test layer's defineModule (testing/compat/fold.ts).

Every part of the desk comes back, now with Quick's fold standing open (S.qAll) and Song info open (S.songInfoOpen): both are view state kept with the session (kit/session.ts), which closes deviation 53.
The button's words closed and open, its place after the tiles across the desk, aria-expanded, no undo step, a click and Enter.
A module added from its card where the fold would hide it opens the fold; Undo takes it and the fold away; adding what is already there, folded, opens the fold and rings it.
A value set on a tile the open fold shows keeps it out of the fold, and the button names one fewer; Undo puts it back in the fold.
Open and closed, each kept over a reload. On the concept page its stand-ins (registered by script) are gone after the reload, so its tiles' counts fail there; its S.qAll comes back.
Studio shows every module with no button; back at Quick the fold is as it was.
Song info opened and closed by its button, each kept over a reload (deviation 53 closed).
